systems.system: Education Management Information System (EMIS) on Open EMIS, with the Annual School Census and EMIS Statistical Bulletin
systems.country_label: EMIS; Open EMIS; Annual School Census; EMIS Statistical Bulletin (Education Statistical Bulletin)
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Training; UNICEF support for EMIS, and the GPE Systems Capacity Grant (USD 1.6 million) to fund the 2020 and 2021 reports
systems.tiers: A database covering pre-primary, primary, lower and upper secondary, formal and non-formal; the last Statistical Bulletin published was for 2020 (2019 in the enabling-factors table), delayed by lack of financing and of capacity for Open EMIS; districts to be supported to collect and use EMIS data

systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Training, with Systems Capacity Grant support for the transition
systems.tiers: Not in use: the ministry will explore the transition, and the possibility of individual child and school-level dashboards with secondary schools

systems.owner: School Readiness Initiative (Roger Federer Foundation with NECDOL)
systems.tiers: Tablets held by mentors, inspectors and teacher trainers for play-based continuous assessment of children in reception classes and early primary grades; the pilot put Grade R in 50 primary schools

systems.country_label: e-governance platforms for electronic records management
systems.owner: Teaching Service Department, Ministry of Education and Training
systems.tiers: Not in use: named as a priority of the decentralisation reform for teacher recruitment, deployment and development

note: No fact: the document treats EMIS as the Annual School Census and its Statistical Bulletin. It calls Open EMIS 'individual-learner supported' but states no entry of learner records by schools; the move to DHIS2 and learner-level dashboards are things the ministry 'will explore'.
